title: Peruvian Crispy Fried Chicken Keto Bites
description: A low-carb, crispy fried chicken recipe with Peruvian flavors and a crumbly coating. Perfect for a keto diet.
instructions: 1. Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (180°C).
2. In a bowl, mix together the crumble, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
3. Cut the chicken breast into small pieces and dip each piece into the beaten egg, then coat in the crumble mixture.
4. Fry the chicken pieces in batches until golden brown and crispy, about 5-6 minutes per batch.
5. Remove the fried chicken from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
